meta.title: The Burning Desert Where Everyone Lives Underground #shorts
meta.description:
Imagine walking through a scorching Australian desert where the ground is literally boiling hot, but there is not a single house in sight. You look down and realize you are actually standing on top of a bustling town with thousands of residents. Welcome to Coober Pedy, the opal capital of the world, where the heat is so intense that locals decided to build their entire lives underground. Here, you will find subterranean churches, underground bars, and even three-bedroom homes carved directly into the pink sandstone. These underground dugouts stay at a perfect, cool room temperature all year round without any air conditioning. It is a completely surreal way of living that feels like a sci-fi movie. Would you ever spend a week living under the earth? Let me know in the comments.
